He plays as a goalkeeper and is the captain "Captain (association football)") for the German club Bayern Munich. The IFFHS named him the best goalkeeper of the decade from 2011 to 2020. A treble means winning the league, the main domestic cup, and the Champions League in one season. He also holds the record for most clean sheets in one season, with 21 in the 2015–16 season. He was the main goalkeeper for the 2010 FIFA World Cup. Four years later, Germany won the 2014 tournament.

title: Bayern Munich No.1 Manuel Neuer: the goalkeeper-revolutionary who has changed the way we see football | Bundesliga
content: # Bayern Munich No.1 Manuel Neuer: the goalkeeper-revolutionary who has changed the way we see football. In a glittering career spanning over two decades and liberally sprinkled with the game’s biggest prizes, Neuer set a revolutionary standard for others to follow, transforming the humble goalkeeper from a mere shot-stopper to a more technically rounded outfield player. Neuer had already showcased his abilities on the game’s biggest stage, and despite a trophyless first season in Munich – Bayern finished second in the Bundesliga and runners-up in both the DFB Cup and Champions League in 2011/12 – he would soon have the silverware to match. He formed the bedrock of the Bayern side that became the first German club to win the treble in 2012/13, reaffirming his standing once and for all as the game’s undisputed No.1 custodian and elevating Bayern’s game to a new level in the process.

title: Manuel Neuer（German professional football athlete）_Baiduwiki
content: Manuel Neuer (born March 27, 1986, in Gelsenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. He currently plays for FC Bayern Munich in the Bundesliga. At club level, Neuer joined the youth team of FC Schalke 04 in 2001. In 2010, Neuer became the captain of Schalke 04 and helped the team win the DFB-Pokal the following year. From the 2019-20 season to the 2020-21 season, Neuer, as captain, helped Bayern Munich win the Sextuple. At international level, Neuer made his debut for the Germany national football team in 2009. In 2014, he won the 2014 FIFA World Cup Brazil with the German national team and was awarded the World Cup Golden Glove. In May 2026, he returned to the German national team and participated in the 2026 FIFA World Cup with the squad.
